claims: The Gambia is Africa's smallest non-island country.
The Gambia is a narrow nation surrounding the Gambia River.
The Gambia is almost entirely enclosed by Senegal.
The Gambia is known as the "Smiling Coast".
The Gambia has a population of over 2.4 million.
The capital of The Gambia is Banjul.
English is the official language of The Gambia.
The Gambia has an area of approx. 11,300 km².
The Gambia is a narrow strip of land following the lower Gambia River.
The Gambia primarily consists of savannah and mangrove swamps.
The culture of The Gambia is rooted in various ethnic groups primarily Malinke, Wolof, Fulani, Diola, and Soninke.
The economy of The Gambia is heavily dependent on agriculture, especially peanuts.
The Gambia has a tourism industry geared towards beaches, nature, and birdwatching.
The Gambia is a former British colony.
The Gambia gained independence in 1965.
The population of The Gambia is predominantly Muslim.
The population of The Gambia has a small Christian minority.
Serekunda and Brikama are the largest urban centers of The Gambia.
Wolof and Mandinka are widely spoken local languages in The Gambia.
The currency of The Gambia is the Dalasi (GMD).
Kunta Kinteh Island is a historical site.
Bijilo Forest Park is an attraction in The Gambia.
Kachikally Crocodile Pool is an attraction in The Gambia.
